relocation_validation.uncertainty: Generic HypoDD SVD reported 2-sigma errors in m; includes conditional measurement covariance, excludes velocity-grid/calibration/association/systematic bias. Every >=4-event six-phase-linked component of each sampled region attempted, not only the largest.

sampling.method: Tan supplement S5 samples 174/165/175/166 events in four regions. Sample without replacement only when more events are available; otherwise retain all. Original regional boundaries unavailable, so masks remain explicit alternatives. Seed 42 is a disclosed reproducibility choice; no published coordinates or errors enter selection.

relocation_validation.zero_cc_scope: Final gap-passing set. Between-round change statistics use all common round-2 outputs, before its final gap filter.

precision_validation.limitation: Held-out refitting and identical-input precision diagnostics were executed on this cohort. Absolute locations and phases remain unvalidated; regional-start and precision gates are retained. See the heldout record for failures as well as successful runs.

heldout.selection: Every fifth chronological candidate, excluded before velocity/station inversion
heldout.method:
Refit without every fifth calibration event; evaluate only withheld events.

Uses the independently selected cohort and exactly the published-method pilot
sequence. No reference catalog or paper locations are used. Conditional residual
improvement does not establish absolute location accuracy or regional robustness.

isotropic_bulk_modulus_check.interpretation: Vp^2 - 4 Vs^2/3 must be positive for positive bulk modulus in an isotropic elastic reference. A diagnostic of the own trial model, not a measurement of rock properties.

magnitude.status: Pilot maximum-curvature estimate; acquisition and magnitude selection incomplete
magnitude.estimator: Aki--Utsu maximum likelihood with half-bin correction; Shi--Bolt sampling error; does not include coverage/systematic errors
magnitude.b_caveat: Conditional descriptive estimate from only 592 selected pilot magnitudes. Neither population completeness nor the regional b-value is established; the formal error excludes selection, magnitude calibration and coverage bias.

panel_summary.sector_masks: Explicit alternative: North y>=1.5 km; remaining East x>=1 km; remaining Southwest x<=-2 or y<=-1 km; remainder Other. Local WGS84 AEQD centered 40.82N 14.14E. No depth filter. These are not the unpublished original masks.
panel_summary.counts: Seven-day bins anchored 21 January 2022; sparse observed-window counts, not exposure-corrected rates. Routine counts are separate context and never seed events. Unobserved weeks are not empirical zeros.
panel_summary.swarm_dates: Written panel-title date ranges from S11; only selection metadata read, never plotted coordinates, magnitudes or count values. End day inclusive assumed.

location_comparison.method: Unique reciprocal own-origin matches within 2 s, no paper catalog; diagnostic only, not proof of event identity

scope: All known event-selected windows excluded from the new detection catalog and coverage. Sparse calendar sampling remains. Original observations, trained weights, alternative association profile and disclosed Tan-distributed starting grid only; routine Md enters only downstream calibration. No author result tables.
